verdict.rationale: Klaviyo is an email marketing platform, so authenticating a custom sending domain with SPF, DKIM and DMARC is a fair axis for it. The evidence pack never mentions domain authentication, DNS records or a verification flow. The only 'authentication' material covers API keys and OAuth, which is a different topic and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can authenticate my own sending domain — SPF, DKIM, DMARC alignment — with guided DNS setup and verification
